question: What is the literacy rate in India as per the Census of 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __74.04%**.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Census of 2011:-**

 
 
• **According to the Census of 2011, the literacy rate in India was 74.04%. **
 
• This represented an increase from 64.8% in 2001. The male literacy rate was 82.14% and the female literacy rate was 65.46%.
 
• **The highest literacy rate was found in Kerala (93.91%) and the lowest literacy rate was found in Bihar (63.82%).**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The total population of India was 1.21 billion, an increase of 18.14% from 2001.
 
• The population of Uttar Pradesh was the largest, with 194 million people, followed by Maharashtra (112 million) and Bihar (104 million).
 
• The population of Delhi was the most urbanized, with 93% of people living in urban areas.
 
• The sex ratio in India was 943 females per 1,000 males.
 
• The child sex ratio (0-6 years) was 914 females per 1,000 males, a decline from 927 in 2001.
 
• The scheduled castes (SCs) population was 16.63% of the total population, while the scheduled tribes (STs) population was 8.03%.
 
• The majority of the population (79.8%) was Hindu, followed by Muslim (14.2%), Christian (2.3%), Sikh (1.7%), and Buddhist (0.8%).
